description: COUNTY LEVEL, FUTURE (next 24 hours to 10 days). AtlasCast Forecast by Address. Use when the question is which storms could affect a county soon. Without a key, returns the exact price quote (count of addresses in the forecast path and price at $0.05/address) and a pay link; with a key it returns the data. County grade and counts by storm type are a paid County Summary (summary=true, $0.02 per county). Input is state plus county. Refreshed 4 times a day. Could happen, not will. Not for past storms (use get_storm_history, get_address_report or get_property_storm_history_report) and not for current weather (use get_current_weather). The paid pull (addresses=true, $0.05 per address) returns one record per address with full_address, lat, lon, county, storm_type, forecast_time and risk_label. For the paid pull, call get_weather_data with dataset=risk and addresses=true (pay with an Atlas United API key, x402, or the card pay link).

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

peril.description: Narrows the forecast to one storm type (e.g. HAIL, THUNDERSTORM_WIND, TORNADO, FLOOD).

name: get_risk_forecast
